en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a cobblestone street flanked by old stone buildings with sloped tiled roofs. One of the most striking features is the medieval-looking gatehouse or fortified city gate at the end of the street. There are a few people walking or standing on the street, and the architectural style suggests Central or Eastern Europe, with distinctively Gothic and Baroque influences. The only text visible on the postcard is a handwritten number '4470' at the top.
